source_title: An Analysis of Iyashi Structure and the Application to Evaluation and Analysis of Goods
abstracted_dimensions: iyashi as an eliciting stimulus
iyasareru as the process of being soothed

stimulus properties separated from the observer's response
matrix_source_scope: This source supports the stimulus-process distinction and goods analysis only; care, routine, reciprocity, completion, and photographic realization below are explicitly cross-source synthesis or design inference.

candidate_definitions.character_moe_care_routine: One adult performs a bounded, observable maintenance or care action without medical or servitude framing.
candidate_definitions.character_moe_shared_domestic_task: Two or more adults act on one ordinary household target with distinct, reciprocal contributions.
candidate_definitions.character_moe_small_completion: One low-stakes task has a visibly legible completed state in the same scene.
candidate_definitions.character_moe_quiet_companionship: Adults share space or attention while performing compatible parallel activities without forced eye contact.
candidate_definitions.character_moe_gentle_reciprocity: Help visibly moves in both directions between adult peers rather than from a permanent server to a recipient.
candidate_definitions.character_moe_routine_state_trace: Material before, during, or after traces make an ordinary repeated activity readable.

reuse_note: Only the cited stimulus-process distinction and general calm-associated goods analysis are attributed to this row's source; all synthesized rules are provenance-tagged, and no paper prose, work, character, image, design, or scene was copied.
mechanisms: a low-stakes completion loop gives one household, garden, or craft task a visible beginning and finished state
care is expressed through attentive maintenance of another adult's object, meal, plant, garment, or shared space
routine continuity is carried by material state traces instead of dramatic escalation
gentle reciprocity lets adult peers alternate small acts of help without debt, servitude, or rescue hierarchy
quiet companionship allows parallel activity and shared attention without compulsory eye contact
one noticed ordinary sensory detail provides a small moment of delight
deliberate handwork and locally focused gaze imply careful attention
ordinary wear and imperfectly lived-in materials make the routine inhabited rather than showroom-staged

photographic_evidence_definitions.adult_shared_folding_handoff: Two explicitly adult peers fold clean cloth across one table; one passes the last piece while the other clears the basket.
photographic_evidence_definitions.adult_garment_mending_exchange: An explicitly adult subject repairs a loose button on another adult peer's worn coat while the peer sorts thread or prepares the next step.
photographic_evidence_definitions.adult_shared_plant_care: Two explicitly adult housemates tend one plant, with damp soil, a watering can, and distinct supporting actions.
photographic_evidence_definitions.adult_drink_and_cleanup_reciprocity: One adult places a simple hot drink near another adult's handwork while reciprocal shared cleanup evidence remains visible.
photographic_evidence_definitions.adult_parallel_reading_and_repair: Adult peers read and repair at the same lived-in table with relaxed posture and compatible, non-identical activities.
photographic_evidence_definitions.bounded_task_completion_trace: A hung repaired garment, stacked dry dishes, swept crumbs, or newly watered soil makes a small finished state visible.
photographic_evidence_definitions.careful_hand_object_contact: Deliberate finger placement and locally focused gaze show attention to one safe ordinary task rather than camera performance.
photographic_evidence_definitions.single_ordinary_sensory_trace: One cue such as steam, rain on glass, sunlit dust, or a drying towel supports calm without cute-prop accumulation.

compatibility_rules: combine one core routine action with one relationship cue and no more than two material state traces
pair ordinary domestic, garden, or craft locations with explicit adult subject metadata and calm available light
allow solo self-care only when a visible completion state exists; use adult peers when reciprocity is core
use focused hands and settled posture for carefulness while keeping facial affect subtle
conflict_rules: do not combine everyday soothing with urgent medical rescue, crisis intervention, or a treatment claim
exclude infantilizing pampering, compulsory service, or gendered domestic servitude
avoid multi-task montage, maximal pastel clutter, and numerous mascot props that obscure the event
reject static costume portraits or glamour poses with no observable task, relationship, or state change
counterexamples: a static service costume portrait labeled healing without reciprocal care or routine
a glamour portrait surrounded by plush toys but lacking action or completion
a clinical therapy or emergency-care scene mislabeled as everyday care
a pristine catalog kitchen with no hands at work or material trace
boundaries: subjects must be explicitly declared adult; never infer age from face, height, body proportions, disability, or styling
care must not be encoded as feminine obligation, submission, unpaid servitude, or dependence
do not claim that a scene treats anxiety, depression, trauma, or any medical condition
do not reproduce a named iyashikei work, character, signature location, costume, prop, or composition
exclude school uniforms, nursery-coded settings, and youth-coded sexualization
do not treat one national domestic style as the universal form of comfort

term_notes.ja: 癒し is supported as the stimulus and 癒される as the response process; 癒し系 is routed as an affective mode, not a costume or body type.
term_notes.ko: 치유계 and 힐링물 remain unverified aliases in this packet and must be resolved by separate Korean terminology evidence; neither may imply medical treatment.
term_notes.zh: 治愈系 remains an unverified alias in this packet and must be resolved by separate Chinese terminology evidence; it may not imply medical treatment.

compatibility_rules: pair one primary nonhuman feature state with at least one human head, gaze, hand, or torso cue
pair tail state with stance, turn direction, and available space
